_doc: Authoritative deployment provenance for the Work-PC QA node. The three SHAs below are deliberately tracked separately and must never be conflated: browser evidence is ALWAYS attributed to deployed_product_sha, never to latest_implementation_sha. Written/updated only by the Fable QA Director (single-writer rule).
latest_implementation_subject: fix: skill injection must include definition_path - Skill tool alone silently fails (KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES #50)
_qa_artifact_base_note: qa/work-pc was branched from local master b04cedb. qa_artifact_sha is populated on each QA artifact commit.
verification_method: Vercel REST API v13 GET /deployments/{id} -> meta.githubCommitSha, read with the Vercel CLI's own stored auth token. NOT inferred from origin/master HEAD, and NOT inferred from `vercel ls` ordering. The alias list on this deployment was independently confirmed to include brain.open-spot.ai, proving this specific deployment is what the QA target URL actually serves.
sha_alignment_note: Production redeployed FIVE times during campaign C001 (256f183 -> 7df9656 -> 266f86a -> 8c33527 -> 8521b0e). Evidence collected 10:58-11:17 UTC straddles the 8c33527/8521b0e boundary, so exact per-probe attribution in that window is ambiguous BY HONEST ADMISSION. This does not invalidate BUG-001 or BUG-002: both defect surfaces are byte-identical across the whole range, verified by git diff, so the findings are build-independent. Recorded rather than silently re-stamped.
notes: brain.open-spot.ai is bound at the Vercel PROJECT level (project: steppe-ai/brain-os), so it auto-follows the latest successful production deployment. Confirmed live via `vercel inspect` alias list.
There is no separate staging environment. QA runs against production, which is exactly why the FIXTURE_REGISTRY gate + real-name synthetic digital-twin naming exist.

current build. BUG-001 and BUG-002 surfaces both byte-identical vs 266f86a (git diff empty on sem-ai-command/index.ts, departments.ts, people.ts), so both findings remain valid across 256f183..8521b0e.

_build_identity_note: The two halves of production are at DIFFERENT commits and only one is identifiable. Never record FULL BUILD VERIFIED while WEB_SHA is UNKNOWN.
_edge_note: v93 (the P1 package) was deployed 2026-09-08 01:50Z and rolled back at 02:10Z after live acceptance found the context-pack token-preflight P1. v94 carries the v92 SOURCE. Edge-only fix reports must NOT be retested against it.
_web_sha_note: The production web app is visibly AHEAD of the rolled-back Edge (live copy "Current manager: none." exists only from master 1048b9e and is absent at f6fa26a), but the exact deployed commit is NOT observable from this seat: no build id, no /api/version (404), no commit meta tag, _next/static path is "immutable". Do NOT infer or invent a SHA. Tracked as OBS-WEB-DEPLOYED-AHEAD-OF-EDGE.
_deployed_product_sha_note: Was "8521b0e" recorded 2026-08-31; that value is STALE and unverifiable now, so it is nulled rather than carried forward as if re-verified (CLAUDE.md §1 stale-provenance trap).
evidence_label_required: EDGE v94 (v92 source) / WEB SHA UNKNOWN

retest_rules.edge_only_fix_reports: DO NOT retest while the deployed Edge source is v92-equivalent.
retest_rules.web_ui_fix_reports: Browser exploration MAY proceed (the web changed), but a bug may NOT be CLOSED until the deployed web build is identified and tied to the implementation fix.
retest_rules.build_independent_defects: Continue exploratory reproduction; label every piece of evidence with the split identity above.
retest_rules.on_new_edge_sha: Start a new build-scoped retest campaign automatically.
retest_rules.on_web_sha_becoming_observable: Update this file and schedule impacted fix reports via changed_primitives (qa/contracts/CAPABILITY_IMPACT_REGISTRY.json).
